description:
[Admin] Ask JobMojito's model for a few clearly different looks for one block type, from the block's content (pass it as block) and the brand's CSS variables. Returns name, description and CSS ready for save_component_style. Nothing is stored: show them and save only the one the user picks. You may also design styles yourself from get_component_style_guide.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

block.description: The block as it is in page content (its title, text, items, layout), so the looks fit what it holds.

block_type.description: The kind of block to design for.

brand_id.description: A sub-brand; leave it out for the main brand.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

instruction.description: What the person wants, in their words.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name: generate_component_styles
title: Generate component style alternatives
